gloss: writhing in agony; fainting from pain

definitions.gloss: writhing in agony; passing out from pain
definitions.explanation: Twisting and groaning in great pain or distress, sometimes to the point of fainting. In casual speech it is used with humorous exaggeration for strong reactions such as a very spicy dish or unbearable embarrassment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶絶|もんぜつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{激辛|げきから}→激辛：19465_gekikara⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{悶絶|もんぜつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ate super-spicy curry and nearly died.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小指|こゆび}→小指：04029_koyubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつけて→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{悶絶|もんぜつ}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stubbed my little toe on the corner of the desk and writhed on the floor for a while.

notes:
A strong, vivid word. In news writing it describes real agony; in conversation and online it is often playful exaggeration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶絶|もんぜつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to writhe in pain
- {悶絶|もんぜつ}⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辛|から}さ: spiciness that makes you writhe
- {恥|は}ずかしさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悶絶|もんぜつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to squirm with embarrassment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer — the general word
- もだえる: to writhe, to squirm — the native verb written with the same first kanji (⟦{悶|もだ}える→悶える：09137_modaeru⟧)
